title: Maximum Subarray
summary: Return the greatest sum of a nonempty contiguous segment.
statement: Return the greatest sum of a nonempty contiguous segment.

examples.explanation: The last two values form the best segment.
Keeping the negative middle connects two gains.

hints: Conceptual: A negative prefix can make a later segment worse.
Directional: At each element, compare restarting with extending the previous segment.
Implementation: Maintain the best sum ending here and the largest ending sum seen anywhere.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
